issues.problem: must_preserve requires '中国消费业务+蚂蚁金服去重合并口径' for the 8.60亿 global annual active consumers figure. Per p19 of the prospectus, 8.60亿 = 中国消费业务 7.30亿 + 国际 1.30亿 (Lazada与速卖通去重, footnote 4) and does NOT include Ant users; the Ant-dedup merged scope belongs to the separate 9.60亿 China users figure (footnote 1). The entry also contradicts the same case's boundary '8.60亿不得写成……含蚂蚁金服中国用户，去重合并口径'.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace must_preserve[2] with: '全球8.60亿＝中国消费业务7.30亿＋国际1.30亿（Lazada与速卖通去重），不含蚂蚁金服用户（蚂蚁金服仅并入9.60亿中国用户口径）'.
